description: This source file defines the 'Authorized' annotation used for specifying authorization requirements on methods or classes within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: Authorized
classes.description: An annotation used to specify authorization requirements for service layer methods or classes, including required privileges and whether all privileges are necessary.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the list of privileges needed to access the annotated method or class.

methods.name: requireAll
methods.description: Indicates whether all listed privileges are required (true) or if having any one suffices (false).
